name: Hourray: Automatic Time Tracker & Focus Timer
notes: The focus timer grows. An hourglass at the heart of the focus card shows the round as sand. Make up to 8 focus modes of your own. Say what a session is for and, after it, what got done; the review page lists each session. An optional daily focus goal, and an optional reminder if you open a site you listed during a round, with Back to work. All off or quiet until you turn them on; tracking is unchanged.
